description: Lists the rooms at Zenith Workspaces (106 Apple Street, Tinton Falls, NJ) that can be booked by the hour or day: six private offices (Everest, K2, Denali, Summit, Atlas, Matterhorn) and the Evergreen Conference Room (seats 10). Returns each room's name, type, capacity, hourly and daily price, and a link to Zenith's booking page and real photos (image_url, images). Use when someone asks what rooms or offices Zenith has. Does not cover monthly offices or suites (quote only).
name: list_spaces
title: List bookable spaces
